title: SQL/EXPLAIN analysis
whenNotToUse: No EXPLAIN output available and you invent one.
promptTemplate:
GOAL:
Interpret EXPLAIN for {{queryPurpose}}.

CONTEXT:
Engine: {{engine}}.

INPUT:
SQL + EXPLAIN: {{explain}}

CONSTRAINTS:
- Do not invent plans
- Propose indexes carefully

OUTPUT:
Bottleneck + next experiment

ACCEPTANCE:
Advice tied to actual plan nodes.

VERIFICATION:
Cite plan lines.
improvedPrompt: Given this EXPLAIN ANALYZE, identify seq scan cause and propose one index experiment.
